## Scope

Documentation location or tool name; hardware revision only if relevant.

## Observation

What was actually measured? Distinguish native status, readback, cold boot and
functional observations. Include a short sanitized result, not a raw device dump.

## Expected result / proposed correction

## Safety and privacy

- [ ] No private NAND/userdata/ROM/saves/keys/serials or complete maps attached.
- [ ] Historical block numbers are not presented as universal flash targets.
- [ ] Any device write is clearly identified; unexecuted proposals are labeled.
